From the first year, a choice of courses is offered ("Interdisciplinary practices in the social sciences" or "Quantifying in the social sciences") offering close supervision (approx. 20 students / course) and personalised follow-up. The curriculum emphasizes three main areas: scientific writing, with specific training in survey reporting; transdisciplinarity, with an openness to the different aspects of the social sciences; and a field approach, with the realization of a training course (survey work) supervised by researchers in sociology, anthropology and political science. Structured around 2 teaching cycles ("disciplines" and "methods"), the first year of the Master's programme enables the foundations of the three core disciplines of PDI to be strengthened and survey methods to be acquired. The 2nd year aims to consolidate and broaden the skills acquired in M1. — Quantification in Social Science This course trains in the reflexive and rigorous use of quantitative methods in the service of research questions in sociology, anthropology, history and political science. It offers a solid training in social sciences and statistics, combined with upstream reflection on the production of data and downstream reflection on their uses. Training through practice with a strong international orientation through partnerships, the track is based on a common thread common to all the lessons - a reflection on the construction of data - to know how to find them, collect or generate them and perceive their limits.

It can also benefit students who wish to train at a high level as cultural interpreters, or more mature students who, for personal or professional reasons, are interested in studying the social sciences. Paris Sciences et Letters University (PSL) is a **public research** and higher educational institute in Paris, France. It was **founded** in 2010 by integrating **11 constituent schools** and educational institutes. PSL provides global educational excellence and an interdisciplinary approach at its research-led institutions. It always prioritizes the students' talent and potential to cultivate creativity and critical thinking. It offers a broad range of disciplines, such as arts, science, and engineering, for bachelor's, master's, and doctorate students.

[PSL](https://psl.eu/en) is the **No. 1 university in France**, with 17000 students, 25 research and higher educational institutes, 140 research laboratories, and about 2900 research-conducting students. It offers **English-taught master courses** for Pakistani students, such as basic sciences, economics, and engineering. The **course duration** for these programs is 1-2 years of master's study. The **average tuition fee** for English-taught master courses is 243 euros per year but can differ department-wise.

To study in English-teaching programs at PSL University, taking the [IELTS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_English_Language_Testing_System) and having a minimum score of 6-6.5 is preferred. Otherwise, you must have a B-2 or C-1 level of English language proficiency. You must have completed a 3-4 year bachelor's degree to enroll in the English-taught Master's program at PSl University. **Scholarships to study at PSL University** are also available: government-funded and merit-based scholarships awarded by the university. **No entry test** is required for international students except for language tests to study at PSL University.

## Why Study at the University of PSL

The University of PSL offers the following benefits for international students on and outside the campus:

* One of the top benefits of studying at PSL University is its **ideal location**. Situated in Paris, one of the most beautiful cities in the world, it offers students an opportunity to explore French culture, architecture, and modern development.
* Among the top 50 universities worldwide, it is the **No. 1 university in France**, offering **quality education** with the highest standards for aspiring students.
* It offers a variety of courses, such as arts, science, and engineering, and more than 20 master's programs are **taught entirely in English**.
* PSL University is one of the most **affordable** universities in the world in terms of tuition fees and study expenses. The average tuition fee is about 250 euros per year.
* PSL University offers partially and fully funded **scholarships** in almost all programs. The French government also awards scholarships to students studying at PSL universities.
* The university primarily focuses on a **research-oriented approach** to boost students' personalized learning and creative thinking.
* The university's collaborative approach allows students to grow **personally and professionally** through various worldwide networking opportunities.
* Students at PSL University will have to pay **lower living costs** than students in top European cities like London and New York. The average living cost for international students to study at the University of PSL is 600-900 euros per month.
* Students can **work part-time** for 964 hours per year while pursuing their studies at PSL University.
* The average acceptance rate for international students at PSL University is also very good—70-80 percent.

* For a doctoral degree, 30-year age limit

| Paris Artificial Intelligence Research Institute (PRAIRIE) Merit Scholarship | All nationals | Paris Artificial Intelligence Research Institute |

#### 4. PhD track Grants

These fully funded scholarships for international research students are valid for five years. The first two years are for completing a master's degree, and the last three are focused entirely on research.

##### Eligibility Criteria for the Scholarship

* Academically excellent students
* Top-quality research proposal
* Experience will be preferred
* A Bachelors or Masters degree
* C-1 level of English language proficiency

##### How to Apply for the Scholarship

* Submit online application
* Give remote-based interviews conducted in English.

##### Documents Required for the Scholarship

* CV
* Academic Transcripts
* Statement of Purpose
* Research project
* Language proficiency certificate

##### Deadline to Apply for the Scholarship

* December 12, 2024, is the official deadline for the scholarship.

##### Scholarship Benefits

* 10,000 euros per year for 2 years in phase 1, along with the disbursement allowance of 1000 euros at the beginning of each month
* 2200 euros per month gross salary for 3 years in phase 2

## Eligibility Criteria

* High school certificate for enrolling in the bachelor's program
* A 3-4 years bachelor's degree is required to study in Master programs at PSL
* To pursue a 5-year PhD, you are required to have a bachelor's degree
* An English language proficiency of C-1 level is required
* Study visa and supporting documents are also needed

Follow the step-by-step process to apply for the University of PSL: 

* Choose your desired program as per your academic background
* Check the availability of programs at PSL University
* Prepare all the required documents
* Log into the PSL online portal
* Complete your profile
* Attach all the required documents
* Submit
* Give an interview if applicable

## How to Enroll in the University of PSL

After getting the offer letter, create an account on the Campus France website.

* Select the admission received option.
* Select your chosen program.
* Select the school of enrollment.
* Provide a letter of your intended stay in France.
* Upload the PSL admission certificate
* Register and save
* Apply for visa
* Book the accommodation

## FAQs

### Q1) What is the acceptance rate for PSL France?

**Answer:** The acceptance rate depends upon your academic profile and the specific course you have chosen at PSL University. The average acceptance rate for international students at PSL University is 70–80 percent.

### Q2) What is the ranking of PSL France?

**Answer:** The PSL university in France is among the top 50 universities in the world. It is ranked 24 according to the QS world ranking, 33rd in the Shanghai rankings, 2nd in the Times Higher Education Young University ranking, and 42 in the Times Higher Education World University rankings.

### Q3) How much is PSL research university tuition fee for international students?

**Answer:** The University of PSL is one of the most affordable universities in France and the world. The average tuition fee for a bachelor's program is 170 euros per year, for a master's program 243 euros per year, and for a PhD program 365 euros per year. 

### Q4) Is the University of PSL public or private?

**Answer:** Paris Sciences et Letters University (PSL) is a public research and higher educational institute in Paris, France. It offers very low tuition fees for international students pursuing bachelor's, master's, and PhD programs. PSL is the top university in France, with 17000 students, 25 research and higher educational institutes, 140 research laboratories, and about 2900 research students.

### Q5) What is the application deadline for the University of PSL in 2025?

**Answer:** The last date to apply for the master's program taught in English for international students for 2025 intakes is March 13, 2025. The application process will start on January 14, 2025.

Description

The result of collaboration between Dauphine–PSL, École Normale Supérieure–PSL, and MINES Paris–PSL, the Master’s Degree in Computer Science trains specialists in computer science in the broad sense, with a focus on organizational science, decision making and data science, and artificial intelligence.  
 The various tracks of the Master’s degree prepare students for either academic research or corporate jobs. The Master’s degree is affiliated with PSL’s graduate program in Computer Science.

[PSL Phd track in computer Science](https://psl.eu/en/phd-track-computer-science)

---

### Learning outcomes

* Provide a high-level education on the topics of fondamental computing, data science and artificial intelligence and decision-making science.
* Focus on research (initial training) and top quality professional training, with many industry-side contributors (Miage program and apprenticeship)

---

### Tracks

**3 tracks in Master year 1 :**

* Fondamental computing *(ENS - PSL)*  
   → courses mainly in English (some options may be in French)
* Computer Science, Decision Making, and Data (IDD) *(Dauphine - PSL)*  
   → courses mainly in English (some options may be in French)
* [Big Data, Artificelle Intelligence (BDIA)](https://tunis.dauphine.psl.eu/masters/big-data-intelligence-artificielle/1re-annee-de-master-big-data-intelligence-artificielle) *(Dauphine - PSL | Tunis Campus)*

**5 tracks in Master year 2 :**

* Algorithmic Science and Foundations of Programming track : Researcher, teacher-researcher, teacher, engineer, etc.: *(ENS - PSL)*  
   → courses mainly in English (some options may be in French)
* [Modeling, Optimization, Decision Science and Organizations track (MODO)](https://dauphine.psl.eu/en/training/masters-degrees/computer-science/m2-modo): Decision support consultant, operational research, computing in functional departments, R&D departments, etc. *(Dauphine - PSL)*  
   → courses mainly in English (some options may be in French)
* [Artificial Intelligence, Systems, Data (IASD) - Computer science track](https://dauphine.psl.eu/en/training/masters-degrees/computer-science/m2-artificial-intelligence-systems-data) : Thesis in artificial intelligence, data scientist, etc.*(Dauphine - PSL)*  
   → courses mainly in English (some options may be in French)
* [Artificial Intelligence, Systems, Data (IASD) - in apprenticeship](https://dauphine.psl.eu/en/training/masters-degrees/computer-science/masters-year-2-artificial-intelligence-systems-data-iasd-in-apprenticeship) *(Dauphine - PSL)*
* Artificial Intelligence, Data and Agentic *(Dauphine - PSL | Tunis Campus)*

**More information on tracks: [ENS-PSL](https://diplome.di.ens.fr/curriculum_fr.html) / [Dauphine-PSL](https://dauphine.psl.eu/en/training/masters-degrees/computer-science)**

---

### Opportunities

Varied career paths depending on the chosen track. Examples include: PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Data Scientist, Software Analyst/Developer, Financial Auditor, Big Data Engineer, Research Engineer, etc.

---

### Admissions

→ **Dauphine-PSL selection process**

* Application file (+ interview for apprenticeship).
* [All information related to the admission process.](https://dauphine.psl.eu/en/training/masters-degrees/applications-and-admissions-for-master)

* See the [admission procedure here](https://diplome.di.ens.fr/admission_fr.html)

**→ PhD Track Application (Master's year 1) [applications closed]**

The Master’s in Computer Science (Fondamental computing track and Computer Science, Decision Making, and Data track) is offered as part of the [Phd track in Computer science](https://psl.eu/en/phd-track-computer-science)

**Admission procedure & application dates**

Applications for the PhD tracks have been closed since December 11, 2025. You may still apply to the Master’s Degree in Computer science (see the application calendar and procedure above).

What is a PSL PhD Track?

A PhD Track is a highly selective, fully funded 5-year program (2 years of Master’s + 3 years of PhD), entirely taught in English. It is intended for high-potential students hoping to become top-level researchers, in France or abroad, in the public or private sector.

→ [**More information about PSL PhD Tracks**](https://psl.eu/en/education/find-your-curriculum/psl-phd-tracks)

---

### Tuition fees

[More information about Tuition fees](https://dauphine.psl.eu/en/training/school/tuition-fees#c56600)

---

### Teaching location

The courses are given in the heart of Paris on the campuses of the PSL schools involved in the Master's program. The students may also spend part of their education abroad, taking advantage of the various international agreements of PSL and the schools involved.
